title: FloVerse Floor Plan-Guided Multi-Modal Navigation
one_line: Floor plan priors boost multi-modal navigation via two-stage diffusion policy.
innovations: Unified multi-modal navigation task with floor plan guidance
ThreeDiff two-stage policy with diffusion-based planner and depth-based refiner
FloVerse-1.6K dataset with 1.6K scenes and 240K expert trajectories
method_framework: Two-stage imitation learning: diffusion-based planner with masked-modality training and depth-based trajectory refiner for obstacle avoidance.
experiment_framework: Gibson simulator, SR and SPL metrics, comparison with ThreeDiff w/o F and single-modality baselines.
takeaways: Floor plan priors significantly improve navigation efficiency, especially for PointNav
Random modality masking enables cross-modal knowledge transfer
weaknesses: Limited evaluation on Gibson 4+ for ImageNav and ObjectNav
Method complexity with two diffusion models increases computational cost
relevance_reason: 导航任务与可靠性主线无实质交点，仅多模态技术有迁移价值
